entities.name: Martín Varsavsky
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martín Varsavsky Waisman-Diamond is an Argentine entrepreneur, philanthropist, and right-wing activist based in Spain who funded several companies worldwide, as well as serving as an early-stage investor in others. Currently, Varsavsky is Executive Chairman and Founder of Prelude Fertility and Chief Executive Officer and Founder of Overture Life.
